title: MY MAP!!

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
There's no need to use redstone. You must define the co-ordinates of the walls in the YAML file after you complete the map.

This explains everything you need to know about writing up the YAML file for Walls maps: 
http://docs.avicus.net/components/walls
